name: Vena Preston
original_name: ヴィーナ・プレストン
source:
[i]"No arguing where I can see you. You'll give me 500 push-ups as punishment."[/i]

[i]Valiant Leader[/i]

The leader of the squad the heroine joins after becoming a Sylphid. She fearlessly leads her squad with her bold, spirited personality. As she joined at the same time as Cyril, they've known each other for a while.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/recordnoah/english/characters/?page=vena]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
